select p.product_id productId, p.product_name productName, p.claim_sun_addmony claimSunAddmony, p.claim_sun_submoney claimSunSubmoney, p.bus_acc_mony busAccMony, d.org_id orgId, d.data_type dataType from think_data_org_product p left join think_data_detail d on think_data_detail_id = d.id left join think_data a on p.think_data_id = a.id where 1 = 1 and a.delete_flag = 0 and p.product_id is not null and state = 3
and date_format(a.think_time,'%Y-%m') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(a.think_time,'%Y-%m') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m')
